text: Among respondents answering the open ended question on other actions taken, 30.8 percent hired a compliance firm, 15.4 percent said they otherwise wasted time and money reacting to Dodd-Frank requirements, and 15.4 percent implemented new policies and programs.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Private Fund Industry Five Years after the Dodd-Frank Act – A Survey Study (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2732915

isBasedOn.name: The Private Fund Industry Five Years after the Dodd-Frank Act – A Survey Study

abstract: 30.8% of respondents who answered this question hired a compliance firm, 15.4% suggested they otherwise wasted time and money in reacting to Dodd-Frank requirements, and 15.4 % suggested they implemented new policies and programs in response to the Dodd-Frank Act.
